Done. The full suite is green (`BUILD SUCCESS`).

## What I changed

The daily limit is a new, self-contained rule added as a small cohesive unit, mirroring the existing `EnsureOwnerCityWithinCapacity` pattern — no existing method or class grew:

1. **`EnsureDailyOwnerLimitNotExceeded`** (new function class) — counts owners whose `registrationDate` equals today and throws `DailyOwnerLimitException` at 100 or more.
2. **`DailyOwnerLimitException`** (new checked exception).
3. **`DailyOwnerLimitExceptionHandler`** (new escalation handler) — responds **429 Too Many Requests** with a `ProblemDetail`, reusing the shared `ProblemDetails.build` helper.
4. **`...DailyOwnerLimitException.yml`** (new escalation wiring).
5. **`owners.POST.yml`** — inserted one `ensureDailyLimit` step into the pipeline after `ensureCityCapacity`.

The check sits after `BuildOwner` (which defaults `registrationDate` to today) and before save, so the count is evaluated pre-insert: the 100th create sees 99 and succeeds; the 101st sees 100 and is rejected with 429. Seed owners have a null registration date, so they don't count.

Structural impact stayed low: every function I authored is brand-new with zero surrounding-class complexity (`WMC_other` = 0), and the only edit to an existing artifact was three added lines of YAML wiring — I didn't modify any existing Java method.

3. **`DailyOwnerLimitExceptionHandler`** (new escalation handler) — responds **429 Too Many Requests** with a `ProblemDetail`, reusing the shared `ProblemDetails.build` helper.
4. **`...DailyOwnerLimitException.yml`** (new escalation wiring).
5. **`owners.POST.yml`** — inserted one `ensureDailyLimit` step into the pipeline after `ensureCityCapacity`.

The check sits after `BuildOwner` (which defaults `registrationDate` to today) and before save, so the count is evaluated pre-insert: the 100th create sees 99 and succeeds; the 101st sees 100 and is rejected with 429. Seed owners have a null registration date, so they don't count.

Structural impact stayed low: every function I authored is brand-new with zero surrounding-class complexity (`WMC_other` = 0), and the only edit to an existing artifact was three added lines of YAML wiring — I didn't modify any existing Java method.
